bagPolicy.summary: Each guest may bring one clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag no larger than 12 × 6 × 12 inches, or a one-gallon clear bag. Nonclear bags and backpacks are prohibited; medical and child-care needs can be accommodated after screening.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking is in the Gold Lot and Expo Park lots. The stadium recommends buying a parking pass before arrival and entering via 39th Street and Figueroa Street or Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard and Hoover Street.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The published pickup and drop-off area is at Figueroa Street and Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard, entered from Figueroa Street. Event-specific traffic plans can change the location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are available inside. Outside food and beverages are prohibited, with an exception for one factory-sealed plastic water bottle up to 20 ounces and approved infant or medical needs.
allowed: One factory-sealed plastic water bottle up to 20 ounces
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The stadium offers assisted listening devices, sensory kits and wheelchair escorts or storage. Request interpretation at least two weeks before the event.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests cannot leave and re-enter BMO Stadium using the same ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The stadium lists its northwest box office as open from 10 a.m. on event days, but does not publish a general concert will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The stadium has seven entrances, but concert entrances and opening times are set for each event. Consult that concert’s Know Before You Go instructions before arrival.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
